title: まずは、なかよくなるため

text_block_list.text: On the way home for the day…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The two of us are currently working hard in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The two of us are currently working hard in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But it still feels like I'm lacking something.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Since I just started at the academy, I need to make way more friends. ☆
As I drop a grinning Curren Chan off at the dorms…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. My apologies, but fret not. She's always like this.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Come on, Sweep. This is just the entrance. It's time for everyone to come back to the dorm, so—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooooo! I'm gonna bask in the moonlight!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm serious this time! I read it in a book! Moonlight gives you magical powers!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… so that's why she refuses to move.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, as the dorm leader, I can't just let her do that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All right, you little witch. Let's get you back to the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!
choice_data_list: …Looks like this is going to take a while.
…Looks like this is going to take a while.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha… We can't just sit back and do nothing, though… Hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If Sweepy doesn't go back to the dorm, that means there's gonna be an extra Jiggly Pudding tonight, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Did you just say pudding?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If there's an extra, is it okay if I eat it? I just looove that sweeeet, delicious Jiggly Pudding. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Drool…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm gonna have two puddings tonight! ♪ Twooo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Don't take my pudding!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. You're funny, Curren.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Your mastery of language has the power to move others into action… Don't tell me you're a witch too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, of course not, silly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But I can be just as self-centered as Sweepy, so I could guess exactly how she'd feel… Teehee. ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But I can be just as self-centered as Sweepy, so I could guess exactly how she'd feel… Teehee. ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's true. After all, the thing that was on my mind more than anything was…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Getting back to the dorm before you started worrying!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Getting back to the dorm before you started worrying!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's pretty self-centered, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha. What an adorable thing to be self-centered about.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, isn't it? Well, as long as you think it's cute, I'm happy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… In that case, I'm gonna ask for one more thing! Hey, Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, Curren? What can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Let me know if you ever need more help, 'kay? As long as you don't mind that I'm a little self-centered. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. My, oh my… I may have to take you up on that sometime.
After that, I start seeing Curren Chan and Fuji Kiseki talking to each other more often.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey! You're supposed to deny that!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey! You're supposed to deny that!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What do you think of my self-centered attitude?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What do you think of my self-centered attitude?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay! You said I'm cute again! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha. You two are definitely on the same page—like a self-centered princess and her loyal retainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Then I'll ask you to be the royal advisor, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Let me know right away if you ever need anything. ♪ We gotta help each other out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Now even I've got a role…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But my liege does seem reliable. Perhaps I could be so bold as to request your assistance somewhere down the road.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, by all means. ♪
After that, I start seeing Curren Chan and Fuji Kiseki talking to each other more often.
